props_prompt:
Create ONE production pixel-art sprite atlas for Midlife Survivors SUPPLY CLOSET props. Match the attached native prop references EXACTLY in top-down three-quarter view, 1 logical pixel navy #171C35 outline, broad 16-bit color clusters, warm upper-left light, limited palette. No anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, realistic shading, drop shadows or text. Final art will be reduced to native game sizes, so keep details broad and simple.
Canvas landscape 16:9, arranged as an even 4 COLUMN x 2 ROW grid, equal 128x144 logical cells enlarged uniformly. Each object centered in its cell with generous transparent margin, no borders, labels or scenery. Transparent background. Do not combine cells.
Top row left to right:
1. A tall narrow METAL SHELF stacked with cream paper reams, three shelves, teal/slate frame. Target native96x112.
2. A matching metal shelf with slate toner boxes, one small sad-looking label-maker device (NO face, NO letters), a dangling blank cream label. Target96x112.
3. An overflowing teal lost-and-found bin with pens, ONE brown shoe, an orange mug and a lavender lanyard. Target64x64.
4. Coffee-orange #EF9347 mop bucket with wringer and a simple mop leaning in it, navy pole, gray mop head. Target48x64. No bright yellow.
Bottom row left to right:
5. One dusty navy office chair with a sagging seat, one crooked caster and a small patch of gray dust on the fabric. Target48x56.
6. A bare hanging lightbulb on a short cord, cream glass, small slate fitting, no glow outside the bulb. Target24x40.
7. A flat square dark gray concrete floor texture tile viewed straight from above, low-contrast slate gray #303750 and #526078, sparse wear, no cracks crossing its outer edge, no shadows or objects. Target64x64, fill the square tile completely.
8. Completely empty transparent cell.
Palette ONLY: #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #A88B70 #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #874C3B #C45C4B #EF9347 #E5A995 #F1B5BF #BFA8CF #B97A58 #70402F.
No people, enemies, words, numbers, brands, logos or watermarks.
door_prompt: One isolated hidden supply-closet doorway for Midlife Survivors, matching this attached native office prop's top-down three-quarter pixel style. Draw ONLY a narrow dark doorway/aperture with slate and teal side jambs, deep navy #171C35 interior and one very thin vertical sliver of warm cream #F2D7A1 light along the right inside edge. No cabinet, no door leaf, no handle, no wall or floor outside it, no signs, lettering or objects. Target96x112 logical pixels, about88 pixels wide and96 high, hard one-pixel navy outlines, broad simple clusters, upper-left light, same limited office palette. One doorway centered with transparent margin, transparent background. Crisp hard pixels, no blur, glow, gradients or realistic texture. This sits BEHIND a filing cabinet that slides aside, so it must be quiet and nearly black.
export: Native nearest-neighbor scaling, exact palette quantization, opaque magenta. Cabinet is copied from source and translated only; bulb second pose brightens glass only. Concrete tile's opposite edges are identical.
